decisions.reason: Reviewing the draft copyright certificate wording does not change the required documentation about whether the logo lettering is custom-made or font-based.
The certificate draft and wording review do not modify the selected logo design, typography treatment, colors, or letterforms.
The word 'wording' refers to the copyright certificate, not the business name or strapline displayed in the logo.
Requesting a draft copyright certificate for review does not alter the requirement to establish and supply brand colors.
The certificate review request does not change the required boxed and unboxed logo variants.
The certificate review request does not change the required full-color, black, and white logo variants.
The request for a draft copyright certificate does not change the editability, formats, or intended uses of the source logo files.
Review of copyright certificate wording is independent of the already delivered initial logo concept set.
The certificate documents copyright transfer and requires wording review, but it does not change the requirement that the logo artwork itself be original.
